shortDescription: Create and manage Koji user accounts

options.name: krb_principal
options.description: Set a single non-default krb principal for this user. If unset, Koji will use the standard krb principal scheme for user accounts. Mutually exclusive with I(krb_principals).

options.name: krb_principals
options.description: Set a list of non-default krb principals for this user. If unset, Koji will use the standard krb principal scheme for user accounts. Your Koji Hub must be v1.19 or later to use this option. Mutually exclusive with I(krb_principal).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Koji user. Example: "kdreyer".

options.name: permissions
options.description: A list of permissions for this user. If unset, Ansible will not edit the permissions for this user. To remove all permissions, set this to an empty list. Example: [admin]

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to set this user as "enabled" or "disabled". If unset, this defaults to "enabled".
